name: MAVEN
description: MAVEN is an out-of-distribution benchmark designed to stress-test multi-step reasoning through explicit verification and adversarial task composition in agentic tool-calling environments, focusing on generalization across diverse domains.
reputation: A new research benchmark from an arXiv preprint; promising for agentic reasoning evaluation but not yet widely established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on multi-step reasoning and adversarial verification in tool-use settings; reveals significant generalization gaps in current models.
